design_choice.target_ABI: current unified protocol and safety with separately maintained F4/H7 firmware
design_choice.send_gate: mock only in this design; future real TX additionally requires verified identities/protocols, both safety readbacks, validated vehicle safety and separately authorized device stage

facts.statement: 锁定官方C++运行链是单SPI板，不是可直接换USB参数的双板驱动；PythonUSB能力、旧panda.bin.signed文件名、DOS schema枚举/测试均不构成运行支持。
SP098包装器内部板排最后；DP内部板排最先。DP的peripheral[0]及DOS+red点火特例依赖它自己的排序；不能把二者拼接，也不能把本机软件DOS自动绑成slot0。SP098 C++源未见，仅以现有Python排序事实作比较。
目标health和版本协议已变化：旧API声明health16/CAN4/CANhealth5与3字节回复，目标0xdd为8字节hash。当前C++health仅err>=0接受短读；USB兼容层必须加精确长度/版本门槛，不能补零健康。 参考DP又是health17/CAN4/CANhealth5，不能因同为DOS就按SP098的health16解包。
主机src以4为板间stride，但MCU只应接本地0/1/2。返回/拒绝用+0x80/+0xC0表示；不是可原样写回sendcan的端口号。
现有selfdrived只遍历收到的pandaStates，不能单靠该循环发现末尾板消失；hardwared/UI还有[0]和任意点火OR假设；CarParams/passive、CanBusBase和诊断查询也带单板/最后块假设。
参考DOS不支持CAN-FD。当前host header首bit名reserved而MCU为fd；正式C++通过每bus CAN-FD auto工作。FD能力与传输USB/SPI、payload长度不可等同，<=8byte也可能是FD帧。
官方与旧包装器均有reset/flash/recover路径，构造Panda也会做写操作；设计中的发现/只读能力验证与正式初始化必须拆开。

design_modules.title: 固定拓扑与身份，不按发现顺序排板
design_modules.design: 采用版本化双required-slot模板，slot只能为0、1；每slot未来由可信配置绑定唯一设备身份、预期板型/MCU、明确USB或SPI、协议profile。roles包含vehicleControl、diagnostic、ignitionSources、harness、peripheral；不由DOS/internal/type排序推角色。真实serial仅留本地配置，不进版本库。USB物理路径只作核对线索，换hub不能自动换板。未知、重复身份、一个设备同时暴露USB/SPI、同slot多候选均隔离，严禁自动选择、重排、缩短。profile hash在一次运行中不可变，重启仍按同一绑定。模板本轮不被任何runtime读取。

design_modules.title: 分离传输、协议与板能力
design_modules.design: 恢复窄PandaTransport接口，USB和当前SPI各自实现。factory只按绑定transport创建，不用USB失败后任意回退。codec纯内存、每板独立接收残片；协议握手先于任何配置写。USB精确处理control返回长度、partial bulk、超时/STALL/no-device和关闭竞态，handle锁按设备。失败写入若已发送字节不明，不重试整包；先使该generation失效。保留当前SPI协议，不能复制旧2048字节头覆盖新4096/id/CRC链。接口选择按VID/PID、预期interface/endpoint和身份白名单；firmware/bootstub分开，unknown隔离。 短头必须先判remaining>=6，禁止照抄size为uint32时的pos<=size-sizeof(header)减法边界（0..5字节会下溢）；所有payload/缓冲区长度先验证再读。二进制fixture核little-endian与6byte布局，不把平台C++位域布局默认当跨平台合同。

design_modules.title: 统一目标ABI，旧ABI只离线解码
design_modules.design: 正式目标为经独立实现/验收的DOS/F4和外置H7使用当前统一CAN/health/safety ABI；旧16/4/5仅显式legacy离线fixture，不把旧health翻译后直接放行目标控制。协议回复长度、hash、health大小、CANhealth大小、板型及期望构件签名必须同profile一致。未知/旧版/短读为quarantined或invalid，绝不启用BOARDD_SKIP_FW_CHECK，不自动刷写修复。按构件manifest匹配specific board+MCU，不能任意panda.bin或panda_h7签名命中就接受。 DP health17另立参考解码fixture，与SP098 health16互相拒收，均不能取得目标控制资格。

design_modules.title: bus和flag单点编码
design_modules.design: 正规host bus=4*slot+local_bus，其中local_bus只能0/1/2；3和7保留，非端口。TX先拒绝returned/rejected标记及未授权bus，再按slot路由并减offset，只发送本地编号。RX先验证local_bus和互斥flag，再加slot偏移和一个状态偏移；正常0/1/2/4/5/6，returned128/129/130/132/133/134，rejected192/193/194/196/197/198。两flag同时置位拒收，避免+320溢出UInt8；不能用src&0x7等掩码把回执伪装普通流。每板MCU safety仍按本地总线定义，host4/5/6永不进入MCU allowlist。

design_modules.title: 能力门控与FD语义
design_modules.design: DOS/F4只允许经典CAN合法长度0..8，不发FD auto/data-rate/non-ISO命令；H7 FD仅在已验证每bus配置下允许。USB是否高速不决定CAN-FD。纯codec保留raw fd bit用于校验/诊断；不把fd塞进src。当前cereal CanData不承载FD位，v1保持H7官方auto语义并把总线模式作为profile限制；若要求同一总线逐帧区分经典/FD的<=8byte TX，v1不能表达，作为后续显式API/schema议题，禁止猜测。F4收到fd标记或>8byte视协议/能力错误。

design_modules.title: 双板生命周期与失效不重映射
design_modules.design: 状态为unbound→discovered→identity/protocol verified→configured-noOutput→two-board safety-readback barrier→ready；任一缺失/失联/短读/身份漂移/签名不符转group-invalid。generation和单调时钟标识会话；每板RX残片与TX队列只属于其generation。任一required板断连立即关闭所有真实TX资格（本轮仅mock gate），取消队列；不将幸存板挪slot，不单板降级。重连只接受原身份原slot，清空旧缓冲，重新核协议与两板读回，且仅在offroad开始新控制epoch；不自动恢复原先engaged状态。新增未知板不参与运行。每板有有限deadline/工作量，慢速DOS不能阻塞另板心跳，100Hz CAN聚合/10Hz健康等上游节奏用fake clock先证明，再留实时实机验收。 TX还必须检查sendcan Event.valid，不能只验证时间戳；RX保留原始采集时间与generation，聚合发布不能给旧帧刷新年龄。MCU拒绝/阻止转发后不能改走另一板重发。时限、队列容量、退出与失联转移预算在阶段0冻结后测边界，不能使用无限等待作为默认。正常退出、已接合退出、持锁断连与断电分别验证，不假定一种继电器动作适用于全部情形。

design_modules.title: 保留cereal布局，固定两条状态且整组有效
design_modules.design: v1明确不改cereal，pandaStates始终长度2且index=slot，两个都是required。任何slot缺失、health过期、短读、版本不符或身份异常，整个Event.valid=false，CAN聚合event亦invalid并禁止控制；不缩列表。缺位只保留last-known板型身份（尚无则unknown），其他占位字段不代表新健康回复，controlsAllowed始终false。有效健康从不补零，不把unknown/默认noOutput当健康通过。具体slot存在/age/error/generation在主机结构化诊断中记录。消费者必须同时校验Event valid、alive/fresh、长度=2和冻结profile；任何失败整组不可用，不依赖placeholder值判安全。当前schema无逐板valid，故不支持局部健康降级；若未来要支持，必须单独审查新增schema。

design_modules.title: safetyConfigs与板级读回屏障
modules: proposed: Song PLUS interface topology adapter
design_modules.design: safetyConfigs固定按slot长2，非控制板明确noOutput；passive也生成两个noOutput，不能缩成1。分别设置alternativeExperience/model/param并读回，两板均匹配且无安全故障才允许进入ready；ControlsReady/FirmwareQueryDone本身不是全板屏障。空/短/长配置、板型/能力不兼容、旧epoch CarParams一律fail-closed。selfdrived补预期数量与有效性检查，仍保留现有safety mismatch/relay/controlsAllowed全板检查；不以任意一板controlsAllowed=true代替全部控制板条件。将来真实TX还须单独完成设备阶段授权、匹配固件/车型safety与实机门槛；本轮SEND gate只模拟。 health中未知fault/enum、非有限数和单位/范围错误也不能补成正常值。

design_modules.title: 角色化点火、外设、线束与诊断
design_modules.design: peripheral/harness/diagnostic/vehicleControl及点火源各自从冻结profile选slot，可同板但不隐含相同。保留每板raw ignition与fault，不改写DOS原始ignition来假装已验证；聚合点火只使用明确允许的slot和line/can来源，并要求整组新鲜有效。所有消费者使用同一策略，禁止hardwared/UI继续任意OR或固定[0]。DP的DOS+red假点火特例仅作待验证线束问题，不复制其基于数组顺序的屏蔽。fan/IR只送已验证peripheral能力所属板，故障不能导致重发到另一块；IR/driver监控缺硬件仍是独立缺口。OBD/ELM327只给diagnostic role，车辆ECU主动查询是TX不属只读；VIN0/1及Request.bus需通过显式诊断映射一致处理。 全局relay/safety/heartbeat故障按所有required板聚合，不能只看vehicleControl板；peripheralState的有效性也受角色板及整组失效约束。 deviceState/风扇请求过期不得当成新指令；整组控制失效不等于关闭散热。内部板失联时的风扇、心跳与降级告警行为需在能力manifest及故障预算中明确，不能把外设控制重定向到另一块板。

design_modules.title: 车型bus和回放来源显式化
design_modules.design: 宋适配不得仅由len(safetyConfigs)或fingerprint最大bus推车辆所在slot；用角色映射生成显式CanBus offset并在CP两槽配置中保持一致。v1不全局改变其他官方车型推断，可为宋增加显式offset接口/适配器并保留上游默认路径。历史日志必须有producer版本和排序provenance，SP/DP各自映射；无板绑定元信息的日志不猜bus所属硬件。回放迁移不得用当前[-1]统一覆写安全参数掩盖双板错序。CarParams cache绑定拓扑profile hash和协议generation，失配不复用。

design_modules.title: 默认不reset/flash的入口与独立离线编译边界
design_modules.design: 将来兼容profile使用独立wrapper入口：默认只拒绝不匹配，不自动reset/recover/flash；不直接调用当前官方或SP/DP wrapper。固件维护拆成明确单板manifest的独立流程，不在manager重启/热插拔链里。未知板quarantine，不使用BOARDD_SKIP_FW_CHECK或allOutput作为兼容方案。抽出codec/router/state-machine为无设备I/O测试目标；Linux USB/SPI构建与macOS纯逻辑测试分开声明，macOS旧minimal成功不能证明AGNOS pandad。测试入口不import Panda构造，不启动manager/pandad，不触碰USB/串口、GPIO、CAN或联网。本轮不实现或构建这些目标。

implementation_order.title: 冻结host contract与两组SRC2 fixture
implementation_order.deliverable: 逻辑slot/role/template、host↔local表、失效语义、历史排序标签；本阶段没有真实身份绑定。
implementation_order.exit: 设计互相一致；两角色fixture覆盖，不要求照片才能开始。

implementation_order.title: 实现纯codec、bus router、协议manifest与能力表（后续授权）
implementation_order.deliverable: 无I/O库和golden fixtures；legacy与target显式分开。
implementation_order.exit: T06–T19预期全通过；无设备运行或固件构建。

implementation_order.title: 实现mock transport与稳定slot生命周期
implementation_order.deliverable: 显式USB/SPI factory接口、fake-clock group状态机、generation/队列屏障。
implementation_order.exit: T01–T10、T20–T23预期通过；不会重排/重放。

implementation_order.title: 接入双板状态、安全配置与所有消费者
implementation_order.deliverable: 固定2条pandaStates、整组valid、角色策略、CarParams两槽/显式bus、回放适配。
implementation_order.exit: T24–T35预期通过；任意缺板/错序/单板健康不能取得ready。

implementation_order.title: 加入真实USB实现及无自动维护wrapper，仅离线编译
implementation_order.deliverable: USB依赖锁/构建目标；Linux与纯逻辑主机结果分别记录；manager入口审查。
implementation_order.exit: T36–T37及Linux编译预期通过；不会触碰设备；本轮尚未实施/编译。

implementation_order.title: 进入独立设备阶段前的门槛
implementation_order.deliverable: 本机/外置板真实身份、MCU/板修订、线束与点火/外设角色、匹配固件和安全实现、恢复条件、阶段授权。
implementation_order.exit: 门槛不足只阻止真实I/O/控制，不阻止前面离线设计和实现；驾驶员相机/告警等完整系统缺口另行解决。

offline_acceptance_cases.input: SRC2-A: synthetic DOS=A, external H7=B; bind A→slot1, B→slot0; enumerate [A,B] and [B,A].
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Both permutations produce identical slot map and host buses; no claim that these are actual unit bindings.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: SRC2-B: same synthetic identities; bind A→slot0, B→slot1; reverse enumeration.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Both permutations still preserve explicit binding; peripheral/diagnostic/vehicle roles do not follow first/internal. Tests also use same hardware types with two distinct identities.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Missing slot0 or slot1 at startup; unexpected third identity or duplicate same identity.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Required map remains two entries; group invalid, no TX, unknown identity quarantined and not opened/configured automatically.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Same identity visible on USB and SPI, or same slot has two matches; USB port/hub path changed.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Ambiguity rejected; no fallback or remapping. Only configured transport+identity accepted.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Restart or attempt profile update while onroad.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Same frozen profile yields same slots across restart; changed profile cannot activate within active epoch.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Every possible split boundary of 6-byte header+payload; zero-byte and concatenated USB packets.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Exact frames reconstructed once, per-board; no bytes from one slot enter another slot parser. 对0..5byte partial header，以ASan/UBSan离线目标验证无unsigned下溢或越界；该目标尚未构建/执行。

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Control health returns 0, short, too long, error, or wrong version.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No zero-padding, no healthy state, no safety barrier completion; group invalid.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Bulk write partly completed then timeout with known/unknown transferred count.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No replay of whole packet; uncertainty invalidates generation and clears pending TX. No duplicate control frames inferred safe.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Disconnect between enumerate/open/read/write/close; concurrent heartbeat and CAN.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No use-after-free or crossed handle; bounded cleanup, original slot stays reserved, no output to another board.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: USB mock selected; SPI mock selected; old SPI header presented to new SPI parser.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Selection is explicit; old frame rejected; USB selection never opens SPI or resets GPIO.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: SP098 legacy 3-byte [16,4,5], DP legacy [17,4,5], and target 8-byte two-hash replies.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Legacy fixture decodes only under legacy offline label, cannot qualify for target ready; no protocol guessing by prefix. SP and DP health decoders reject each other despite sharing CAN4/CANhealth5.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Wrong firmware signature, right signature for wrong MCU/board, unknown capability.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Manifest mismatch quarantines; no flash, reset, bypass flag or TX.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Target health flags and boundary-value fields; truncated alternativeExperience/safetyParam. Include unknown fault/enum, unit boundary and non-finite decoded values.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Exact golden values preserved with correct signedness/width; missing values are invalid, not 0. Unknown/invalid health never becomes a zero-filled healthy report.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Each slot×local bus0/1/2, both SRC2 role fixtures.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: host4/5/6 route only to slot1 header.bus0/1/2; no MCU bus4/5/6, no other slot TX.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: TX sources3,7,8,128..255 and returned/rejected examples132/196.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject reserved/unmapped/status sources before transport; never strip flags into ordinary TX.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: RX normal, returned only, rejected only, both bits; local bus3..7.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Valid flags produce exact src tables; both bits/reserved bus rejected without UInt8 overflow or wrap.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Bad checksum or incomplete frame at end of old generation then reconnect.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No publish of corrupted frame; group invalid; clear old residual. Offline codec records recovery intent without control_write.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: F4 payload0..8 incl8, length9/12/64, fd bit on <=8; FD config requests.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Classic0..8 accepted by capability mock; all FD/oversize/config writes rejected for F4. H7 accepts only supported legal DLC and configured mode.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: H7 same <=8 bytes as Classic and FD, FD auto transition, impossible DLC lengths9/10/11.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Raw fd preserved in diagnostics; no claimed differentiation in current CanData; ambiguous per-frame TX unsupported, illegal lengths rejected.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Required board disconnects during engaged mock; pending messages exist on both slots.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Group TX gate closes immediately in simulated event step, both queues clear; slots unchanged; heartbeat engaged false and controller fault visible; no automatic resume. A firmware rejected or forwarding-blocked frame must not be retried through the other board.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Reconnect same identity with new uptime/generation or different identity at same port.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Same identity must revalidate entire barrier; different identity quarantines; stale CAN/health/CP/sendcan from old epoch rejected.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Fake-clock slow DOS bulk timeout while H7 heartbeat is due.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Per-board bounded work prevents head-of-line blocking; heartbeat deadlines tracked, missed deadline invalidates group; no claims about real C3XL latency. Freeze numeric deadline/queue budgets before implementation acceptance and test just-before/at/after boundaries.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Late sendcan (>1s upstream bound), future timestamp, previous-epoch sendcan. Include Event.valid=false with an otherwise fresh timestamp.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Drop; reconnect cannot replay buffered actuation. Ready barrier and current epoch also required for otherwise fresh frames. Invalid sendcan is never eligible; aggregator publishing must not renew old RX frame age.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Last slot disappears after two valid states.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: pandaStates length stays2, event.valid=false; placeholder controlsAllowed=false; selfdrived does not treat shortened list or silent default as success.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Fresh envelope but one stale health or one missing/unknown state.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Group validity false; hardwared/UI/selfdrived ignore all health for readiness and expose communication failure; no stale ignition start.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Event.valid=false while raw ignition/old controls flags would otherwise be true.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: All consumers reject readiness; no first-board exception, no healthy interpretation of placeholder.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: SafetyConfigs length0/1/3, wrong order/model/param/alternativeExperience.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject before ready; exactly two slot configs required, unchanged model/enum meaning.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Only one board reports expected safety; second stale/no reply or fails after initial readiness.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No target TX before both valid readbacks; later failure closes group gate. One controlsAllowed true never substitutes other required control board.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Passive mode; one vehicle-control role and one peripheral-only role.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Two noOutput entries in passive; active mock explicit noOutput for non-controller and validated model for controller. Device stage authorization remains false for all tests.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: SRC2-A and B with peripheral/vehicle/diagnostic on opposite slots; mock fan/IR/harness. Include stale deviceState/fan requests and internal peripheral-board loss.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Each request targets role owner only; no duplicate writes or use of array[0]; unverified peripheral capability causes explicit unavailable state. Do not equate invalid control group with fan-off or silently move thermal control to the other board.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Conflicting ignitionLine/ignitionCan, non-authority DOS high, authority low, absent authority.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Raw states retained; aggregation follows same configured sources in pandad/hardwared/UI; absent/stale authority cannot start; no copy of DP order-based quirk.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: OBD multiplex/VIN/FW query under each role fixture and passive/offline gate.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Only diagnostic slot and translated local bus receive mock request; no real query; unsupported role/bus rejects and cannot leak to other board.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Two safetyConfigs but vehicle role slot0; only slot1 fingerprint populated; inverse fixture.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Explicit Song bus mapping stays role-selected, never blindly4*(len-1) or fingerprint max; other official default behavior unaffected.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Historical SP098 and DP traces with known producer ordering; unlabelled trace.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Separate mapping provenance, no automatic DOS-first assumption; unknown trace cannot become board-confirmed evidence.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: CarParams cache from other topology/profile; legacy migration writes[-1].
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject cache for target session; no migration that overwrites wrong slot to force mismatch pass; original fixture retained.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Boot wrapper mock mismatch, process restart, unknown hotplug, DFU device.
offline_acceptance_cases.expected: No reset/flash/recover calls; no bypass env; events diagnostic only. New profile is inert until explicit future implementation.

offline_acceptance_cases.input: Offline target with file/device/network access denied and all transport calls replaced by mocks.
